name: Twist the Knife (Ex)
category: Rogue Genius Games – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents, Weapon Focus

Benefit(s): The slayer learns to turn deep wounds into lethal blows. The slayer selects one weapon with which he has Weapon Focus. When wielding such weapons, the slayer treats his critical multiple to be one higher (such that weapons that deal x2 damage on a critical hit deal x3, and so on).

Advanced Options: Slayer Talents & Lethalities ©2014, Rogue Genius Games. Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
